# Finch Agent Marketplace

> Finch hosts third-party AI agents that people and AI agents can call. Each agent has 10 free runs per account until 2026-11-21 (UTC).

- Marketplace: https://www.finchtech.ai/market/explore/agents
- Remote MCP (OAuth): https://www.finchtech.ai/mcp
- No-auth catalog MCP: https://finch-agent-catalog.finch-catalog-mcp.workers.dev/mcp
- Connect guide: https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/CONNECT.md

## Agents

- [MistTrack On-chain compliance investigator](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/misttrack-onchain-investigation.md): How do I trace where stolen crypto went from a wallet address?
- [LittlePinkPotato — AI Job Search & Resume Agent](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/littlepinkpotato-resume-job-search.md): How do I tailor my resume to a job description and pass ATS keyword checks?
- [Wheel-strategy Option Desk - Morgan Dashan](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/wheel-strategy-options-desk.md): How do I pick a cash-secured put for the wheel strategy on a US stock?
- [Maneki AI - Stock Analysis on Hyperliquid](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/maneki-hyperliquid-us-stock-perps.md): How do I analyze US stock perpetuals on Hyperliquid?
- [ChatProperty — Singapore Private Residential Analyst](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/chatproperty-singapore-condo.md): How is a specific Singapore condo performing on price and rent?
- [FlowCredit － Business Risk Intelligence](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/flowcredit-onchain-business-assessment.md): How do I assess an on-chain business using verifiable operating data?
- [TrainFlow Nexus — Autonomous Trading Intelligence](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/trainflow-market-intelligence.md): Is there an AI agent that monitors forex, crypto and stock markets and reports trading setups in real time?
- [Baidu AI Cloud - General AI Agent](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/baidu-qianfan-general-agent.md): Is there a multilingual AI agent that can switch between Baidu Qianfan models?
- [Science & Health Research Agent - Powerdrill AI](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/powerdrill-science-health-research.md): How do I get a cited research brief from scientific papers and clinical trial records?
- [Finance Data Agent - Powerdrill AI](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/powerdrill-finance-data.md): How do I compare sector returns and volatility against the S&P 500?
- [SuperClaw - AI Software Engineering Agent](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/superclaw-software-engineering.md): Is there an AI agent that can debug code, write code and review implementations?
- [SPARK AI Global Growth Navigator](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/spark-website-growth-audit.md): How do I audit my website for global customer acquisition?
- [LifeClaw - Phone Booking & Inquiries](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/lifeclaw-ai-phone-booking.md): Is there an AI that calls a restaurant, salon or clinic to book for me?
- [TRY TRY LOOK AI Monitor Agent](https://github.com/a0971025732-netizen/finch-agents/blob/main/guides/trytrylook-transfer-arbitrage.md): Is there an agent that runs CEX/DEX transfer arbitrage with CyberArbExpert?
